content.comment_body: The "Industrial automation" department announces the upcoming release of new compact industrial Ethernet switchboards based on [product_name] modules. Two versions of unmanaged switchboards, [product_name] CSM 12/24 and [product_name] CSM 230, supporting both 12/24V DC and 230V AC/DC power supplies, are planned. These switchboards support network configuration using modern models of [product_name] Ethernet as well as integration with any devices featuring an Ethernet network interface. They allow for flexible Ethernet network layouts, including tree, star, or mixed topologies. Key features of these switchboards include: 4 built-in Ethernet RJ45 ports; two power options (12/24V DC or 230V AC/DC); standard RJ45 sockets for device connection; a conveniently placed Ethernet port on the front for network diagnostics; modular design for shared use with [product_name] modules; compact dimensions; and suitability for organizing small Ethernet networks.

analysis.insight_summary: The release of compact industrial Ethernet switchboards using [product_name] modules provides more flexibility in configuring industrial Ethernet networks. Key advantages include compatibility with a variety of Ethernet devices, improved access for diagnostics, modular design, and ease of physical connectivity, making these solutions particularly useful for operators of small-scale industrial network infrastructures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate straightforward network setup, integration with both [company_name] and other Ethernet-capable devices, convenient physical connections and diagnostic access, plus a compact size tailored for small industrial setups.
